testo:
■ Whenever your opponent would put a creature that costs 4 or less into the battle zone from anywhere other than their hand, your opponent puts that creature into their graveyard instead.
■ Whenever your opponent would choose a creature by the effect of a spell that costs 4 or less, they can't choose this one.
testo_jp:
■ 相手のコスト4以下のクリーチャーが、手札以外のどこからでもバトルゾーンに出る時、相手はかわりにそのクリーチャーを墓地に置く。
■ コスト4以下の呪文の効果によって、相手がクリーチャーを選ぶ時、このクリーチャーは選べない。
